title: Pure health function architecture
requirements: Export health() from src/health.mjs with no inputs and fresh {"status":"ok"} result.
Use Node built-in tests and preserve the existing package test command.
constraints: Pure function; no I/O and no added dependencies.
nonGoals: HTTP services, gateways, databases and access-control deployment are outside this task.
risks: Callers must not assume this function checks external dependencies.
rejectedAlternatives: An HTTP service is unnecessary for this accepted function-only task.

decisions.text: Export health() from src/health.mjs returning a fresh status-ok object without inputs.

sections.title: Context and goals
sections.content: A caller invokes health() to receive a pure status-ok result. No service or deployment architecture is introduced.
sections.rationale: The accepted function-only scope needs no infrastructure.

sections.title: Boundaries and contracts
sections.content: AS-IS: package test entry exists, implementation pending. TARGET: export health() from src/health.mjs, no inputs, a fresh object exactly {"status":"ok"}. No I/O, dependencies or HTTP behavior. KNOWN DEVIATION: source and tests pending.

sections.title: Testing and integration
sections.content: Node built-in tests at tests/health.test.mjs verify result shape and fresh objects. Preserve node --test tests/health.test.mjs. Governance controls task worktree, independent review, canonical integration and progress. GitHub CI validates fixture behavior through the suite PR.
